patches_added.name: Input without the ADB server
patches_added.description: Keeps key, pointer and gamepad input working when the "ADB speed up" server is not running. The app only asks whether speed-up is enabled, not whether the server it starts as the shell user on localhost:15000 is up, and it drops the request without falling back when the port is closed - so numpad keys and mouse input do nothing. Each of those requests is now gated on the app's own port probe, and the injection site's ordinary path runs while no server is listening.

patches_added.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_added.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_added.name: Accent color
patches_added.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_added.name: Advanced downloads
patches_added.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Video quality starts at Highest, retaining Metra's existing default. Configure these controls in Metra settings > Downloads.

patches_added.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_added.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_added.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Always upload in HD
patches_added.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: App lock
patches_added.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Automatic video advance
patches_added.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_added.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_added.name: Block author button
patches_added.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Block contact list access
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Block popups
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_added.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Change app name
patches_added.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_added.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_added.description: Adds a note to Metra's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Comment send fix
patches_added.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Comment tools
patches_added.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches_added.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_added.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.

patches_added.name: Device privacy guard
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Metra settings > App behavior. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_added.name: Disable telemetry
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_added.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_added.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Double-tap controls
patches_added.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_added.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Expand activity list
patches_added.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_added.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Metra settings > Diagnostics.

patches_added.name: Feed text sizes
patches_added.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_added.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_added.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Ghost mode
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_added.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_added.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_added.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Feed controls.

patches_added.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_added.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_added.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox items
patches_added.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_added.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_added.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_added.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_added.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_added.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_added.name: Hide video overlays
patches_added.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_added.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep a streak going
patches_added.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_added.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_added.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_added.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep the app language
patches_added.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: LIVE controls
patches_added.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_added.name: Lift text length limits
patches_added.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Limit background traffic
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Location access governor
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Long-press controls
patches_added.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Look like the store app
patches_added.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Mute feed videos
patches_added.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Network proxy
patches_added.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Metra's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Network request report
patches_added.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_added.name: Not interested button
patches_added.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Notification controls
patches_added.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_added.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Playback quality
patches_added.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_added.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Profile background
patches_added.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_added.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_added.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_added.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Remove card scanner assets
patches_added.description: Removes TikTok's bundled payment card scanner files. Keeps the content credential and runtime libraries loaded by other features, including photo comments. Card scanning may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches_added.name: Remove creation tools
patches_added.description: Removes the bundled face-detection model and effect-creation component. Keeps the shared photo and video editor needed by comment pictures. Face effects and effect creation may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches_added.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_added.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_added.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_added.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Run beside the store app
patches_added.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_added.name: SIM spoof
patches_added.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.

patches_added.name: Share sheet tools
patches_added.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches_added.name: Show LIVE search
patches_added.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Show author region
patches_added.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_added.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Show engagement rate
patches_added.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Show follow status
patches_added.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar
patches_added.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. A seek bar for video stories is there too.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_added.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip content warnings
patches_added.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_added.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_added.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_added.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip update checks
patches_added.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_added.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop saving search history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_added.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Story controls
patches_added.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Subtitle tools
patches_added.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches_added.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_added.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Trust user certificates
patches_added.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_added.name: Turn off haptics
patches_added.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_added.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_added.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Use system font
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_removed.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_removed.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_removed.name: Disable long-press repost
patches_removed.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_removed.name: Enable Live search
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_removed.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_removed.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_removed.name: Hide AI content
patches_removed.description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.

patches_removed.name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos
patches_removed.description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.

patches_removed.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_removed.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_removed.name: Share sheet modification
patches_removed.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_removed.name: Show seekbar
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_removed.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds diagnostic logging, crash capture, reports, and an optional rolling feed debugger.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Metra settings > Feed controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on and stop For You reloading when you tap Home. Starts off, except holding Home to open Metra settings. Find it in Metra settings > Feed navigation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_modified.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's Auto scroll action available without starting it automatically. Control it in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Each has its own switch, and both start off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and App behavior for the rewards button.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts on, retaining Metra's existing default. Control it in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Metra settings > Interface. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Metra settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Metra's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Metra patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.

patches_added.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_added.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_added.name: Accent color
patches_added.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_added.name: Advanced downloads
patches_added.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Video quality starts at Highest, retaining Metra's existing default. Configure these controls in Metra settings > Downloads.

patches_added.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_added.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_added.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Always upload in HD
patches_added.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: App lock
patches_added.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Automatic video advance
patches_added.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_added.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_added.name: Block author button
patches_added.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Block contact list access
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Block popups
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_added.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Change app name
patches_added.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_added.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_added.description: Adds a note to Metra's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Comment send fix
patches_added.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Comment tools
patches_added.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches_added.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_added.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.

patches_added.name: Device privacy guard
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Metra settings > App behavior. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_added.name: Disable telemetry
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_added.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_added.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Double-tap controls
patches_added.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_added.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Expand activity list
patches_added.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_added.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Metra settings > Diagnostics.

patches_added.name: Feed text sizes
patches_added.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_added.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_added.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Ghost mode
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_added.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_added.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_added.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Feed controls.

patches_added.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_added.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_added.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox items
patches_added.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_added.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_added.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_added.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_added.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_added.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_added.name: Hide video overlays
patches_added.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_added.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep a streak going
patches_added.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_added.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_added.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_added.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep the app language
patches_added.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: LIVE controls
patches_added.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_added.name: Lift text length limits
patches_added.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Limit background traffic
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Location access governor
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Long-press controls
patches_added.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Look like the store app
patches_added.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Mute feed videos
patches_added.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Network proxy
patches_added.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Metra's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Network request report
patches_added.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_added.name: Not interested button
patches_added.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Notification controls
patches_added.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_added.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Playback quality
patches_added.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_added.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Profile background
patches_added.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_added.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_added.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_added.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Remove card scanner assets
patches_added.description: Removes TikTok's bundled payment card scanner files. Keeps the content credential and runtime libraries loaded by other features, including photo comments. Card scanning may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches_added.name: Remove creation tools
patches_added.description: Removes the bundled face-detection model and effect-creation component. Keeps the shared photo and video editor needed by comment pictures. Face effects and effect creation may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches_added.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_added.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_added.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_added.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Run beside the store app
patches_added.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_added.name: SIM spoof
patches_added.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.

patches_added.name: Share sheet tools
patches_added.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches_added.name: Show LIVE search
patches_added.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Show author region
patches_added.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_added.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.

patches_added.name: Show engagement rate
patches_added.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Show follow status
patches_added.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar
patches_added.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. A seek bar for video stories is there too.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_added.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip content warnings
patches_added.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_added.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_added.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_added.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Skip update checks
patches_added.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_added.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop saving search history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_added.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Story controls
patches_added.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Subtitle tools
patches_added.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches_added.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_added.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Trust user certificates
patches_added.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_added.name: Turn off haptics
patches_added.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_added.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_added.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_added.name: Use system font
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_removed.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_removed.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_removed.name: Disable long-press repost
patches_removed.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_removed.name: Enable Live search
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_removed.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_removed.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_removed.name: Hide AI content
patches_removed.description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.

patches_removed.name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos
patches_removed.description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.

patches_removed.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_removed.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_removed.name: Share sheet modification
patches_removed.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_removed.name: Show seekbar
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_removed.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds diagnostic logging, crash capture, reports, and an optional rolling feed debugger.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Comments and translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Diagnostics.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Metra settings > Feed controls.
